review_basis: Final top-down PNG after deterministic validation round 2

review_items.concrete_reason: The south-east door opens into an empty turning area; cabinet_files is north of the door clearance and desk_chair is farther north beyond the central approach.
The open center branches directly to the dedicated access targets for all four objects, and deterministic path checks reached every target.

desk_chair faces desk_work with pull-out room; both storage fronts are unobstructed; armchair_reading has a clear north-east approach, with side_table_reading set back on the south-east flank and floor_lamp_reading on the west flank.
The paired desk zone is visually primary in the north-east, while the diagonal chair, side table, and lamp form a compact secondary reading zone in the south-west.
Perimeter storage and the two corner activity zones leave a deliberately broad central circulation field without making either activity zone feel isolated.
The task seat faces its desk, wall storage faces inward, and the reading chair turns toward the room instead of a blank wall; the desk sits beside rather than inside the north-window clearance.
The larger desk_work footprint and direct entry-to-work route establish focused work as primary, while armchair_reading remains a distinct but smaller retreat.

Against the closest home_office_001, this scene adds an east file-storage zone and dedicated reading light, moves the work focus to the north-east and reading focus to the south-west, and changes the opening and circulation organization rather than mirroring or shifting the old group.
